title: Trepan (+1)
summary: A +1 trepan with nurse-only damage and NPC-only Trephination.

fields.Weapon profile: Simple, one-handed, Finesse and Light. 5 ft melee. +1 to attacks. Hit for 1d6 + 1 Piercing plus Strength or Dexterity.
fields.Trephination: NPC-only Action with proficiency, once per Short Rest. On a hit add Piercing equal to proficiency bonus and 1d6 Necrotic. Dexterity save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Prone for 2 turns.
fields.Player limitation: The source reports Flourish, Piercing Strike and Trephination are all unavailable to the player with this item. Nurses also deal 1d6 additional Necrotic.
fields.Inspiration: Collecting all the nurses’ tools can grant Right Tool for the Job to Criminal characters.
fields.Acquisition: Sister Vanessa in the House of Healing.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
